missing_requirement_candidates.description: RTL layout behavior is independently testable and can fail separately from translation-string coverage.
The repeated unresolved question about allowing users to change language inside the app describes a potentially independent selection behavior.
Language- or locale-specific social-media link routing is independently testable and is not merely application-text translation.
Adding an FAQ to both mobile applications is an independent feature; the target Requirement captures only the FAQ localization aspect.
